Hi Sarah — thanks for the detail and the usage file. Per Kim’s note, we ran three options for AnchorHealth (short summary below). I’ve attached a formal proposal PDF and a draft amendment/SOW for procurement.

Option A — Short bridge (recommended if you need speed)
- 90-day price hold on current effective unit price for incremental usage above baseline
- One-time bridging credit: $60,000 applied to the first invoice after amendment execution
- No long-term commit change; full true-up at current list for any remaining overage after 90 days

Option B — Commit uplift + credit (preferred for predictability)
- New committed tier: 1.2M tokens/month (12-month term)
- Discount: 15% off list for generation tokens on the committed volume; embedded tokens discounted 10%
- One-time bridging credit: $60,000 applied pro rata across first two invoices
- 30k token burst capacity included per month (no extra charge)
- Price hold: 12 months from amendment effective date for committed units

Option C — Phased uplift + step-down true-up (for conservative procurement)
- Initial 6-month interim commit at 900k tokens/mo, then automatic reprice at month 7 if usage sustained to 1.2M
- Discount: 12% on committed volume, bridging credit $40k
- 6-month price hold on committed units

Notes/Constraints:
- The bridging credit is contingent on amendment execution and a single PO that references deal RDW-ACCT-4852.
- We can convert to a Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) but that requires lead time (approx. 6 weeks) and separate onboarding SOW.
- We included a forecast worksheet in the proposal to show month-by-month cost under each option.

Attachment(s): redwood_proposal_AnchorHealth_v3.pdf (pdf), SOW_AnchorHealth_2027-04.docx (docx)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which option you want to pursue (A/B/C) and procurement contact for PO language.
2) If Option B, we’ll prepare amendment + DocuSign and route for signature; target effective date = 1 June 2027 to align with your R&D onboarding.

On the pricing specifics: I pulled comps for similar mid-market health platforms — 15% is at the upper end of our commit discount band and will require an annual term commitment. If procurement needs different invoicing cadence or longer SOW review, flag now and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call Thursday to walk through the proposal.

—Marissa
